tidbit: Did you know… about 20,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Government websites experienced outages after artificial intelligence identified long-standing critical PHP vulnerabilities, triggering urgent patch alerts globally. This is confirmed by Information Age.
DeepSeek has raised 15 billion dollars in a challenge to leading US labs. Bloomberg reported this development.
Google Cloud and NVIDIA have launched Vera Rubin Infrastructure for artificial intelligence workloads, expanding A5X to Europe for large-scale training and inference with early adoption by Ineffable and WPP. The Fast Mode reported this.
Nuix has launched agentic artificial intelligence in Nuix Neo with audit trails built in, providing traceable and source-linked answers for legal and compliance investigations. This is confirmed by TradingView.
Watchtower Labs raised 35 million dollars to build artificial intelligence decision software for military operations and was selected by the Defense Innovation Unit in January 2026. Pulse 2.0 confirmed this.
Free every hour.
